description:
Create a post-purchase satisfaction survey with advanced participant segmentation. 

1. Login to LimeSurvey (admin/Admin123!).
2. Create a new survey titled 'Q4 2024 Post-Purchase Customer Satisfaction'.
3. Add a question group 'Purchase Experience' and at least one question.
4. Initialize participant tokens for the survey.
5. Define 4 custom token attributes with these exact descriptions: 'Customer Segment', 'Store Region', 'Loyalty Tier', 'Annual Spend Bracket'.
6. Add the following 8 participants with their attributes populated:
   - Sarah Mitchell (s.mitchell@globalretail.com): Premium, Northeast, Gold, High
   - James Rodriguez (j.rodriguez@globalretail.com): Standard, Southeast, Silver, Medium
   - Wei Chen (w.chen@globalretail.com): Premium, West, Gold, High
   - Aisha Patel (a.patel@globalretail.com): Budget, Midwest, Bronze, Low
   - Marcus Thompson (m.thompson@globalretail.com): Standard, Northeast, Silver, Medium
   - Elena Kowalski (e.kowalski@globalretail.com): Premium, Southeast, Gold, High
